title: When do Chinese people Cut their Hair?
synopsis: On February 2nd of the lunar calendar the hair salons in China are packed with people.

fullText.simplified:
中国人喜欢什么时候剪头发

    在中国，哪天理发店人最多？那应该是农历二月二日。
    农历二月二日，是中国二十四节气里的惊蛰，意思是“天上的春雷惊醒蛰居的动物”。中国有句俗语叫“二月二，龙抬头”，表示冬天过去了，春天开始了，冬天里沉睡的龙也在春雷声中抬起头来。
     而人们认为，在这一天剪头发，会让人在这一整年里都有好运气。特别是很多地方不喜欢在正月，也就是农历一月剪头发，像中国北方很多地方认为“正月剃头死舅舅”，所以正月不能剪头发，一直到二月二日，又正好是剪头发的好日子，理发店里就会挤满了人。
    当然这都是一些迷信，人们也知道这没有什么科学根据，但人们还是喜欢在二月二日这一天去剪头发，讨个吉利。
fullText.traditional:
中國人喜歡什麼時候剪頭髮

    在中國，哪天理髮店人最多？那應該是農曆二月二日。
    農曆二月二日，是中國二十四節氣裡的驚蟄，意思是“天上的春雷驚醒蟄居的動物”。中國有句俗語叫“二月二，龍抬頭”，表示冬天過去了，春天開始了，冬天裡沉睡的龍也在春雷聲中抬起頭來。
     而人們認為，在這一天剪頭髮，會讓人在這一整年裡都有好運氣。特別是很多地方不喜歡在正月，也就是農曆一月剪頭髮，像中國北方很多地方認為“正月剃頭死舅舅”，所以正月不能剪頭髮，一直到二月二日，又正好是剪頭髮的好日子，理髮店裡就會擠滿了人。
    當然這都是一些迷信，人們也知道這沒有什麼科學根據，但人們還是喜歡在二月二日這一天去剪頭髮，討個吉利。

raw.synopsis: On February 2nd of the lunar calendar the hair salons in China are packed with people.
sentence_translations: When do Chinese people like to cut their hair?
In China, on what day are the hair salons the most crowded?
That must be on February 2nd of the lunar calendar.
The lunar February 2nd is "Insect's Wake" of the Chinaese 24 solar terms.
It means that “the spring thunder in the sky will rouse the secluded animals.”
China has a proverb that goes: “On February 2nd, the dragon raises its head”.
It expresses that the winter is over and spring has begun.
The dragon that sleeps during the winter has also risen its head from the sound of the summer thunder.
Thus people believe that cutting their hair on this particular day will give them good luck for the entire year.
In particular, in a lot of areas it is not popular to cut your hair during January of the lunar year.
Like in a lot of areas in northern China where they believe “cut your hair in lunar January and your uncle will die.”
So you can't cut your hair throughout lunar January, and lunar February 2 happens to be a good day for hair cutting.
So the hair salons are filled with people.
Of course this is just superstition, and people know that this does not have any scientific basis.
But people still like to go to cut their hair on lunar February 2nd, to bring good luck.
